conceptual_change: Shift from relative close-level liquidity assessments to a volatility-adjusted deviation model. This primitive identifies potential liquidity sweeps by analyzing the deviation of the VWAP distance from its rolling average, effectively filtering for mean-reversion setups when the VWAP is significantly tighter than the local trend baseline, indicative of consolidation before a sweep.
rationale: This candidate is a proposed executable test derived from the selected screen survivor. It does not assert efficacy, causality, market behavior, or any performance result.
